log: A `citizens` provider on City sends the mood of each working citizen ('unhappy' | 'content' | 'happy', from calculateCitizenState), and the moods after each non-zero Happiness/Unhappiness yield with that yield, so a renderer can draw the citizens and the Happiness report's steps without re-implementing the rule (civ-clone/web-renderer#277).
Registered through `registerAdditionalData(game)`, imported from index.ts as registerRules is. Adds core-data-object as a dependency.
